firm_data.firm_description: Clifford Chance is a global law firm advising clients on energy, infrastructure, environmental transactions, regulatory, tax, M&A, private capital, technology and Latin American matters.
notable_facts: Opened Houston office in 2023 to expand the firm's global Energy & Infrastructure practice.
Houston office has grown to more than 40 attorneys.
Charles Adams re-elected as Global Managing Partner for a second term commencing May 1, 2026.

additional_contacts.name: Sharis A. Pozen
additional_contacts.title: Regional Managing Partner for the Americas

email.subject: AI for Clifford Chance, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Charles,

Your Houston expansion into Energy and Infrastructure is exactly the kind of growth that demands smarter workflows. We've been watching how top-tier firms scale specialist practices across new markets, and it's clear that precision and efficiency are non-negotiable.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of growing practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in London to meet global firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete at scale.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
